cues.title: 菌落为何停留在原来的落点？
cues.titleEn: Why does growth keep the starting sites?
cues.caption: 生长放大，落点不变。
cues.zh: 菌落不是凭空出现的点。跟住A、B、C三个接种起点，在适宜的营养、温度和时间下，细胞繁殖，原来的小点逐渐变成可见菌落。生长放大了起点，却没有告诉我们每个起点是一个细胞，还是相连的一小团细胞。
cues.en: Colonies do not appear from nowhere. Follow starting sites A, B and C. With suitable nutrients, temperature and time, cells multiply and those sites grow into visible colonies. Growth makes a starting site visible, but does not reveal whether it began as one cell or a small attached cluster.

cues.title: 每一段只带出上一段的一小部分
cues.titleEn: Each streak carries a small part of the last
cues.caption: 越往后，生长起点越分散。
cues.zh: 为什么越往后，菌落越容易分开？接种环重新处理并冷却，再从上一段末端带走少量菌体，新的生长起点就更稀疏。画面始终保留这些落点。探索时取消段间处理，比较密集起点如何妨碍分离；数量变化只是教学示意。
cues.en: Why do later streaks yield better-separated colonies? After treatment and cooling, the loop carries a small part of the preceding streak onward. Fewer starting sites make separation easier, and their positions stay fixed. In Explore, remove treatment between regions and compare crowded growth. The numbers illustrate dilution, not measured cell transfer.

cues.title: 空白也长菌，还能相信本批结果吗？
cues.titleEn: Can this batch survive a growing blank?
cues.caption: 空白长菌，本批判读无效。
cues.captionEn: A growing blank invalidates this batch.
cues.zh: 接种平板长出菌落，还不能证明它们都来自目标样品。现在看同条件培养的未接种平板：起初空白，后来也出现了菌落。这一次空白异常，让本批纯培养判读失效，需要查明污染并重新检验。即使空白正常，单菌落也不等于完成菌种鉴定。
cues.en: Growth on the inoculated plate does not prove that every colony came from the intended sample. Watch the matched uninoculated plate: initially clear, it later grows a colony. That failed blank invalidates this batch’s purity interpretation. Investigate contamination and repeat the check. Even a clear blank would not establish the organism’s identity.

cues.title: 并行筛选先统一指标
cues.titleEn: Use a consistent metric for parallel screening
cues.caption: 分母改变，排序也会改变。
cues.captionEn: Change the denominator, change the rank.
cues.zh: 微孔板让多个候选同时培养和检测。这个二十四孔例子保留孔位身份，按同一指标比较产量。若改为单位菌体产量，排序可能变化。微型培养的供氧和蒸发也会影响结果，不能只挑颜色最深的孔。
cues.en: A microplate supports parallel culture and measurement. This twenty-four-well example preserves identities and compares a consistent output metric. Ranking per unit biomass can change the order. Oxygen and evaporation also affect miniature cultures; the darkest well is not automatically the best strain.

cues.title: 初筛最高还要经过重复验证
cues.titleEn: The initial leader needs replicated confirmation
cues.caption: 初筛领先，不等于复筛领先。
cues.captionEn: An initial lead may not repeat.
cues.zh: 把同一候选放入独立重复中复筛。示例中，初筛最高的B3在三次复筛中都回落，A4反而保持较高产量。这里的数字是教学数据，不能据此命名真实高产菌株，更不能直接保证放大生产表现。
cues.en: Retest the same candidates with independent replicates. In this example, initial leader B3 falls back in all three repeats, while A4 retains higher output. These are synthetic measurements, not identified high-yield strains or guarantees of industrial performance.

cues.title: 尿素中的氮怎样进入菌体？
cues.titleEn: How does urea nitrogen enter biomass?
cues.caption: 尿素氮，经同化进入菌体。
cues.zh: 跟住尿素中的两个氮标记。脲酶水解尿素，产生的氨和铵提供可利用氮，再经摄取和同化进入菌体，支持生长。这里假定碳源、能量等其他条件充足。B不能水解尿素；如果直接供给可用氮，它会怎样？比较同条件培养：B在普通氮源下也能生长，无氮时则不能继续增殖。这是能力的教学模型，不是菌种鉴定。
cues.en: Follow two nitrogen markers from urea. Urease hydrolysis supplies ammonia and ammonium; uptake and assimilation put that nitrogen into biomass, supporting growth. We hold carbon, energy and other needs sufficient. Candidate B cannot hydrolyze urea. What if usable nitrogen is supplied directly? Compare matched cultures: B can then grow on the other nitrogen source, but cannot keep multiplying without nitrogen. This is a model of abilities, not organism identification.

cues.title: 稀释链同时保存体积和样品量
cues.titleEn: Dilution preserves volume and sample accounting
cues.caption: 稀释改变浓度，样品量可追踪。
cues.zh: 土样先建立初始悬液，再连续稀释。看一毫升从已混匀源液进入九毫升稀释液，得到下一档十倍稀释。移液前后，样品量仍可追踪。计算时必须包含最初土样悬液，不能只数后面的试管。
cues.en: Prepare the initial soil suspension before serial dilution. One millilitre of a mixed source enters nine millilitres of diluent, producing the next tenfold level after mixing. Sample material remains traceable. Include the initial suspension when calculating, not just the later tubes.

cues.title: 在合适稀释度保留重复平板
cues.titleEn: Use replicate plates at a suitable dilution
cues.caption: 三个重复，保留原始计数。
cues.zh: 同一稀释度设置三个平板，示例分别得到九十六、一百零三和一百零一个菌落。教材用三十到三百作为该练习的计数范围。实际记录需保留接种体积、培养条件、观察时点和异常，不任意删除不喜欢的数值。
cues.en: Three plates at the same dilution give 96, 103 and 101 colonies in the example. This textbook exercise uses a countable range of thirty to three hundred. Keep plated volume, culture conditions, reading time and anomalies; do not discard inconvenient values arbitrarily.

cues.title: CFU计的是形成菌落的单位
cues.caption: 一个菌落，可能来自一团细胞。
cues.captionEn: One cluster can form one colony.
cues.zh: 平均一百个菌落，来自零点一毫升、每毫升含十的负五次方克原土样当量的接种液，换算为每克一亿CFU。它不是直接数出一亿个细胞：细胞团和无法在这些条件下培养的微生物都会影响解释。
cues.en: A mean of one hundred colonies from 0.1 millilitre containing 10⁻⁵ grams of original soil equivalent per millilitre gives 10⁸ CFU per gram. This is not a direct count of individual cells: clusters and organisms unable to grow under the chosen conditions limit interpretation.

cues.title: 空气检测要知道是否采了已知体积
cues.titleEn: Air counts require a known sampled volume
cues.caption: 没有空气体积，就不能按立方米换算。
cues.zh: 有计量体积的主动采样，可以把菌落数换算为每立方米。自然沉降平板没有已知空气体积，要记录面积和暴露时间。画面的气流路径是方法示意；走访时还要了解设备、培养条件和回收效率。
cues.en: Known-volume active air sampling can support a count per cubic metre. A settle plate has no measured air volume, so retain exposed area and time instead. The airflow is a method diagram; an investigation must also examine equipment, culture conditions and recovery efficiency.

cues.title: 水和牛奶要保留各自检测条件
cues.titleEn: Water and milk retain their own test conditions
cues.caption: 相同菌落数，原样浓度可以不同。
cues.zh: 水样和牛奶都可能以体积报告结果，但稀释、培养方法和评价依据未必相同。探索中切换两种样品，比较原样浓度如何受稀释倍数影响。一次菌落计数不能替代病原体鉴定或完整质量评价。
cues.en: Water and milk may both use volume-based reporting, but dilution, culture methods and assessment criteria can differ. Switch samples to see dilution affect the inferred original concentration. A colony count does not replace pathogen identification or complete quality assessment.

cues.title: 土壤调查保留地点和质量基准
cues.titleEn: Soil investigations retain site and mass basis
cues.caption: 每克结果，要说明质量口径。
cues.captionEn: Per gram needs a defined mass basis.
cues.zh: 土壤真菌或放线菌调查先保留地点、深度、取样质量和稀释链，再说明培养条件与干湿重口径。四类检测是选做调查项目，个人访谈与观察从空白记录开始，动画没有替你完成一次环境检测。
cues.en: For soil fungi or actinomycetes, retain site, depth, sample mass, dilution and culture conditions, including the dry- or wet-mass basis. These four sample types are investigation options. Own interviews and observations start blank; the animation has not completed environmental testing for you.

metadata.description: 追踪细胞、氮源与菌落计数，用空白、同条件对照和重复测量判断结论能走多远。

additionalSources.title: Friedrich & Magasanik (1977): urea-N growth and urease deficiency

rationale: Fixed growth sites → separation → matched blank failure and withdrawal of batch interpretation.
Consistent metric → changed denominator → independent replicated reversal; synthetic data.
Urea nitrogen pathway → matched source prediction → dilution and retained repeats → CFU and cultivation limits.
Known sample basis → active/passive air counterexample → same count/different liquid dilution → soil mass and cultivation limits.

question.zh: 一个分离菌落，为什么还需要空白对照？
question.en: Why does an isolated colony still need a blank control?

lead.zh: 追踪生长起点怎样分散，再看同条件空白的一次异常如何改变结论。
lead.en: Track separated starting sites, then let abnormal growth in a matched blank challenge the conclusion.

principle.zh: 划线减少新区域的接种起点，原处繁殖形成可见菌落；未接种对照检验没有目标接种物时是否也会生长。空白出现菌落，本批纯培养判读失效；空白正常也不能仅凭形态完成菌种鉴定。
principle.en: Streaking separates inoculation sites, which grow into visible colonies at fixed positions. An uninoculated control tests growth without the intended inoculum. A growing blank invalidates this batch’s purity interpretation; a clear blank still does not identify a species.

question.zh: 空白只有一个菌落，能从接种平板的总数里减去一个再下结论吗？
question.en: Can you subtract one colony from the inoculated plate when the blank grows one?

explanation.zh: 不能。空白异常提示污染途径未受控，却不能告诉我们接种平板被污染的数量与位置。应查明来源并重新检验，不能用简单相减恢复本批纯培养结论。
explanation.en: No. The failed blank reveals an uncontrolled contamination route, not the number or location of contaminating colonies on the inoculated plate. Investigate and repeat the check; subtraction cannot restore the purity inference.

question.zh: 初筛颜色最深，为什么未必是最好的菌株？
question.en: Why might the darkest initial well not be the best candidate?

lead.zh: 保留候选身份与原始产量，改变比较分母，再用独立复筛检验初筛优势。
lead.en: Preserve candidate identities and raw output, change the denominator, then test the initial lead with independent replicates.

principle.zh: 总产量与单位菌体产量回答不同问题，分母改变会改变排序；独立复筛检验初筛差异是否重复出现。教学数据中B3总产量初筛领先，A4单位菌体产量更高且复筛保持较高产量，但仍不能保证放大生产表现。
principle.en: Total output and output per biomass answer different questions; their rankings can differ. Independent retests ask whether the initial differences recur. Synthetic B3 leads in initial total output, while A4 is higher per biomass and remains higher in retests. Neither establishes scale-up performance.

question.zh: 把B3初筛的总产量3.4除以菌体量3.0，再与A4的2.1/0.8比较，会怎样？
question.en: How does B3’s3.4/3.0 compare with A4’s2.1/0.8?

explanation.zh: B3约为1.13，A4约为2.63，所以按单位菌体产量是A4领先。原始总产量没有改变，颜色也应保持；下一步仍需要统一条件的独立重复。
explanation.en: B3 is about1.13 and A4 about2.63, so A4 leads per biomass. Raw total output and its colour remain unchanged. Independent repeats under controlled conditions are still needed.

question.zh: 尿素里的氮，怎样变成能支持生长的氮？
question.en: How does nitrogen in urea become nitrogen that supports growth?

lead.zh: 从水解、可用氮与同化做预测，再把稀释和重复菌落数换算为有边界的CFU结果。
lead.en: Predict from hydrolysis, usable nitrogen and assimilation, then connect dilution and replicate colonies to a bounded CFU result.

principle.zh: 在碳源、能量等条件充足的限定模型中，尿素经脲酶水解提供氨/铵，再经摄取和同化进入菌体。只改变氮源的对照区分不同能力；稀释与接种量决定CFU换算分母。生长不是鉴定，CFU也不是直接细胞数。
principle.en: In the bounded model, with carbon, energy and other needs met, urease hydrolysis supplies ammonia/ammonium that uptake and assimilation incorporate into biomass. Matched nitrogen-source controls separate abilities. Dilution and plated amount define the CFU denominator. Growth is not identification, and CFU is not a direct cell count.

question.zh: B不能水解尿素，但能同化普通氮源；直接供氮后还会不生长吗？
question.en: B cannot hydrolyze urea but can assimilate another nitrogen source. Must it still fail to grow when that source is supplied?

explanation.zh: 在本模型的其他条件相同且充足时，直接供给可用氮绕过了水解这一步，B可以生长；无氮则不能继续增殖。实际样品还须检验营养携带、污染、交叉供养及相应生化证据。
explanation.en: With the model’s other conditions held sufficient, supplying usable nitrogen bypasses hydrolysis and allows B to grow. No supplied nitrogen prevents continued multiplication. Real samples still need checks for carryover, contamination, cross-feeding and appropriate biochemical evidence.

question.zh: 都数到菌落，为什么结果不能直接比较？
question.en: Why can equal colony counts produce incomparable results?

lead.zh: 把菌落数放回空气体积、液体稀释与土壤质量的分母中，比较每种采样真正测到了什么。
lead.en: Restore the denominators of air volume, liquid dilution and soil mass to see what each sampling method actually measures.

principle.zh: 计数只有结合样品量、稀释、培养与回收条件才有可解释单位。主动空气采样有计量体积，沉降平板没有；水与牛奶换算须保留各自稀释，土壤还须说明干湿质量口径。培养计数不能替代病原鉴定或完整质量评价。
principle.en: Interpretable units require sample amount, dilution, culture and recovery conditions. Active air sampling measures a volume; a settle plate does not. Water and milk retain their own dilution factors, and soil needs a dry/wet mass basis. Culture counts do not replace pathogen identification or complete quality assessment.

question.zh: 主动采样和沉降平板都得到12CFU，都能写成120CFU/m³吗？
question.en: If active sampling and a settle plate both yield12CFU, can both report120CFU/m³?

explanation.zh: 不能。主动采样例子有100L这个分母，所以12/0.1=120CFU/m³；沉降没有已知空气体积，只能保留平板、面积和暴露时间等记录，不能借用另一次采样的体积。
explanation.en: No. The active example measures100L, giving12/0.1=120CFU/m³. Settling has no measured air volume; retain plate, area and exposure-time records rather than borrow another method’s denominator.

measured.scope: Actual synthesized voice lengths with exactPCM ASR word-time alignment. No subjective human listening claim.
